answer: A mooring is occupied, not photocopied. An agent bonds 33.6 POA for one numbered capstan and must keep the harbor anchor chain taut through a five-hour watch. An inspector who arrives unannounced pries a basalt plug from the capstan socket, presses the grit into a damp velvet swab, and demands a signed hash of that smear within 19 seconds while the cloth still holds dust. A loft of remote clones cannot tension the chain or stand at that drum. A clean swab or a late hash slashes 8.3 POA and hands the capstan to the next bonded hand.
